lines.say: a form of vitamin B3 the body turns into NAD+, which cells use to make energy
blood NAD+ rose in 5 of 8 small trials; whether it rises inside cells is unclear
no change in fasting blood sugar, insulin or HbA1c vs placebo (8 small trials)
no change in blood fats vs placebo (8 small trials)
better muscle insulin sensitivity in one small trial of women with prediabetes
higher NAD+ might feed tumor growth, reviewers say (theoretical)
its by-product nicotinamide has a possible link with heart disease risk (theoretical)

ask: Since trials found no change in blood sugar or cholesterol, how would we tell whether NMN is doing anything for me?
